commit_message: Expose ADR0127 Sprite Animation to Project Rust
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Extends the existing ABI v3 Project Rust Animation command family with deferred SpriteAnimator2D play/pause/stop and stable-AssetId clip selection, plus the copied deterministic Sprite Animation state view. This isolated request reproduces the previously successful Project Rust slice on current-main v6 before Editor workspace integration.
